# Built-in brand marks

apitu includes a bounded catalogue of 107 brand marks for diagram nodes.
A mark never replaces the node type, color, label, or relationships.

Use `node bin/apitu.mjs brands --json` to list available marks.
For an explicitly requested website, `node bin/apitu.mjs brands capture <url> --json`
returns a digest-pinned brand value. Normal rendering does not capture remote images.

Brand names and logos identify the corresponding technologies; inclusion does not imply endorsement.
